coordinate_contract.negative_extent: allowed and normalized by maze core
coordinate_contract.generator_constraints: owned by each generator and stricter than the core contract
coordinate_contract.canonical_blocked_invariant: every blocked key lies inside the normalized extent
coordinate_contract.legacy_direct_mutation: can violate the invariant; checked operations report NAVSYS_STATUS_CORRUPT_STATE

translation_contract.legacy_wrapper_semantics: translates blocked world keys; no longer performs a metadata-only reset
translation_contract.success: origin and every blocked key move by the same delta; width and height are preserved
translation_contract.failure: origin, extent metadata, blocked keys, equality, and hash remain unchanged
translation_contract.resize_api: not present in ABI 1.x; direct public field mutation remains a legacy ABI limitation

unit_cases: negative and nonzero origin translation round trip
equality and hash translation round trip
